source_identification: UC Berkeley Preliminary Exam, Spring 1979, containing Problems 1-20 in source order.
card_reconciliation: The existing complete collection SRC-BERKELEY-PRELIM-SPRING-1979 represents all twenty source positions in order by nineteen source-local cards plus exact canonical reuse of P-BERK97S-08 for Problem 11. No collection path is modified in this intake because the live shared tree owns those paths separately.
known_source_or_extractor_defects: Problem 8's matrix-size glyph is rendered as an unreadable B-by-B-like symbol in the deterministic extraction; the existing card states only that M is a nonsingular real square matrix and does not infer a dimension.

Problem 13's displayed initial-condition equation has a 3-by-3 matrix acting on a three-entry initial vector but Flash renders the right-hand side as a two-entry zero column. The existing card preserves the unrecovered right-hand side explicitly rather than inventing it.
